faq.question.0: [es] How does SignalBoost choose a language?
faq.answer.0: [es] SignalBoost uses the saved cookie, saved browser preference, browser locale, and English fallback.
faq.answer.1: [es] Yes. The dashboard language switcher persists the selected locale in a cookie.
